one_liner: Senior supervisory contracting officer role advising Marine Corps leaders on major defense acquisitions, setting procurement policy, and managing a contracting staff.
fit_summary: This NH-4 role requires a year of GS-13/NH-03-level experience with expert knowledge of the FAR, DFARS and Navy contracting policy, plus supervision. Daniel's contracting-related work is contractor-side proposal writing and supply purchasing at IEM, and his supervision is a five-person intake team in 2019, so he would not qualify.
eligibility: Open to the public, but this is a notice flyer for anticipated vacancies with a separate application process, and there may be no actual hires.

At least one year of specialized experience equivalent to GS-13/NH-03, including expert knowledge of federal, DoD, and Navy contracting statutes, regulations, and contract types, plus supervising a staff.
A bachelor's degree is required for the 1102 series. His M.A. (George Mason, 2016) implies one.
Secret security clearance is required; you must be able to obtain and maintain it.
